name: merge-gapfill
description: (A) Merge & gap-fill (STO-SCN-142). method=fill-holes (DEFAULT): LOCAL hole-fill that closes walkable-surface gaps while PRESERVING the open scene (no balloon) — the right operation for our open-scene meshes. method=poisson: global screened Poisson (closed objects only — balloons open scenes; n_threads=1 to avoid the ARM64 PoissonRecon race). Pure CPU; consumes the upstream meshify/condition mesh (canonical gauge preserved); NOOP when the identity exists. @1: added method+hole_size (the @0 Poisson-only experiment nodes are preserved). NEW additive task -> existing meshify identities untouched.

method.note: fill-holes = local gap-fill, preserves open scene (default); poisson = global seal (closed objects)

hole_size.note: fill-holes: max hole boundary size to fill (mesh units); leaves the big open (sky) boundaries

poisson_depth.note: Poisson octree depth (higher = more detail, slower)

density_quantile.note: drop Poisson verts below this density quantile (the ballooned skirt); 0 = off

samples.note: oriented points sampled from the surface to feed Poisson
